# VHD interoperability fixture

`qemu-9.2-dynamic.vhd.bz2.b64` is a bzip2-compressed, base64-armored dynamic
VHD produced by QEMU 9.2.4 with a 2 MiB block and `force_size=on`. Its logical
payload is 32 KiB and has SHA-256
`0dcde7c94a6d08ba49304eb929e45dbf9460e018db91060efd692cd516750824`.

The image SHA-256 is
`855483113cc44d4b13971a2e7441b10f5d93e73c87d110a4a74b0f7147b46ee1`.
